decisions.reason: The source includes the É accent in one exploratory champagne-gold distribution but does not change its locked geometry, derivation, alignment, or revision policy.
Applying champagne gold to the second V's right arm in one comparison option does not change the second V's form, hierarchy, construction method, alignment, or geometric relationships.
The source requests material-finish and color-distribution comparisons using the existing wordmark; it does not change spacing, kerning, baseline, scale, case, or composition rhythm.
Selective coloring of the Hero V's right arm does not alter the approved Hero V geometry or any of its construction, alignment, symbolism, or locked-asset constraints.
Keeping non-selected elements black during a material comparison does not change the custom construction, proportions, architectural language, or fixed-asset boundary of the internal letterforms.
The client's assessment of warmth and sophistication is applied to candidate material finishes and does not revise the established brand-expression principles or positioning.
The source varies champagne-gold placement on signature elements but does not change the shared terminal gesture's geometry, character, conclusion, or application rule.
The material-treatment comparison remains entirely within the existing wordmark and neither introduces a separate icon or monogram nor changes the wordmark-led identity architecture.
